description.value: Millstone is a small family farm winery and vineyard situated in Nanaimo, crafting wines that reflect the unique character of Vancouver Island's coastal terroir. The estate offers tastings by appointment and regular walk-in hours, making it a relaxed rural stop for cyclists exploring the East Wellington area. As a working farm vineyard, it provides a distinctly local taste of BC wine country outside of the Okanagan.
